```python
import json
from gurobipy import GRB, Model, quicksum

products = [0, 1, 2]
periods = list(range(8))

initial_stock = [22, 18, 25]
required_final = [18, 15, 20]
hours_per_unit = [2, 3, 1]
min_lot = [24, 20, 28]
max_lot = [82, 70, 90]
setup_cost = [52, 60, 45]
holding_cost = [1.2, 1.6, 0.9]

production_cost = [
    [5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8],
    [7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10],
    [9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6],
]

demand = [
    [34, 48, 42, 55, 38, 50, 46, 40],
    [28, 32, 45, 36, 50, 34, 42, 39],
    [40, 35, 38, 44, 36, 48, 41, 45],
]

capacity = [250, 245, 235, 260, 240, 255, 245, 265]

m = Model("packing_plan")
m.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)

x = {}
y = {}
inv = {}

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        x[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name=f"x_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")
        y[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"y_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")
        inv[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=75, name=f"inv_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")

m.setObjective(
    quicksum(
        production_cost[p][t] * x[p, t]
        + setup_cost[p] * y[p, t]
        + holding_cost[p] * inv[p, t]
        for p in products
        for t in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE,
)

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] >= min_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"min_lot_{p+1}_{t+1}")
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] <= max_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"max_lot_{p+1}_{t+1}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, 0] == initial_stock[p] + x[p, 0] - demand[p][0], name=f"balance_{p+1}_1")
    for t in range(1, len(periods)):
        m.addConstr(inv[p, t] == inv[p, t - 1] + x[p, t] - demand[p][t], name=f"balance_{p+1}_{t+1}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, len(periods) - 1] >= required_final[p], name=f"final_inv_{p+1}")

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(quicksum(inv[p, t] for p in products) <= 150, name=f"total_inv_{t+1}")
    m.addConstr(quicksum(hours_per_unit[p] * x[p, t] for p in products) <= capacity[t], name=f"capacity_{t+1}")

m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products for t in periods) <= 18, name="total_setups")

for t in (2, 5):
    m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products) <= 2, name=f"max2_setup_T{t+1}")

m.optimize()

status_names = {
    GRB.OPTIMAL: "OPTIMAL",
    GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
    GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
    GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
    GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
    GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
    GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
    GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
    GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
    GRB.CUTOFF: "CUTOFF",
    GRB.SOLUTION_LIMIT: "SOLUTION_LIMIT",
}

if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    variables = {}
    for v in sorted(m.getVars(), key=lambda var: var.VarName):
        val = float(v.X)
        variables[v.VarName] = 0.0 if abs(val) < 1e-9 else val
    solution = {
        "status": "OPTIMAL",
        "objective": float(m.ObjVal),
        "variables": variables,
    }
else:
    solution = {
        "status": status_names.get(m.status, str(m.status)),
        "objective": 0.0,
        "variables": {},
    }

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(solution, separators=(",", ":")))
```

import json
from gurobipy import GRB, Model, quicksum

products = [0, 1, 2]
periods = list(range(8))

initial_stock = [22, 18, 25]
required_final = [18, 15, 20]
hours_per_unit = [2, 3, 1]
min_lot = [24, 20, 28]
max_lot = [82, 70, 90]
setup_cost = [52, 60, 45]
holding_cost = [1.2, 1.6, 0.9]

demand = [
    [34, 48, 42, 55, 38, 50, 46, 40],
    [28, 32, 45, 36, 50, 34, 42, 39],
    [40, 35, 38, 44, 36, 48, 41, 45],
]

prod_cost = [
    [5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8],
    [7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10],
    [9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6],
]

capacity = [250, 245, 235, 260, 240, 255, 245, 265]

m = Model("packing_plan")
m.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)

x = m.addVars(products, periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="x")
y = m.addVars(products, periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="y")
inv = m.addVars(products, periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=75, name="inv")

m.setObjective(
    quicksum(
        prod_cost[p][t] * x[p, t]
        + setup_cost[p] * y[p, t]
        + holding_cost[p] * inv[p, t]
        for p in products
        for t in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE,
)

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] >= min_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"min_lot_{p}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] <= max_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"max_lot_{p}_{t}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, 0] == initial_stock[p] + x[p, 0] - demand[p][0], name=f"balance_{p}_0")
    for t in range(1, 8):
        m.addConstr(inv[p, t] == inv[p, t - 1] + x[p, t] - demand[p][t], name=f"balance_{p}_{t}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, 7] >= required_final[p], name=f"final_inv_{p}")

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(quicksum(inv[p, t] for p in products) <= 150, name=f"total_inv_{t}")

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(quicksum(hours_per_unit[p] * x[p, t] for p in products) <= capacity[t], name=f"capacity_{t}")

m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products for t in periods) <= 18, name="total_setups")

for t in (2, 5):
    m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products) <= 2, name=f"max2_setup_{t}")

m.optimize()

status_names = {
    GRB.OPTIMAL: "OPTIMAL",
    GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
    GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
    GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
    GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
    GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
    GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
    GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
    GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
}

if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    solution = {
        "status": "OPTIMAL",
        "objective": float(m.ObjVal),
        "variables": {
            v.VarName: float(v.X)
            for v in sorted(m.getVars(), key=lambda var: var.VarName)
        },
    }
else:
    solution = {
        "status": status_names.get(m.status, str(m.status)),
        "objective": 0.0,
        "variables": {},
    }

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(solution, separators=(",", ":")))
```

```
import json
from gurobipy import GRB, Model, quicksum

products = [0, 1, 2]
periods = list(range(8))

initial_stock = [22, 18, 25]
required_final = [18, 15, 20]
hours_per_unit = [2, 3, 1]
min_lot = [24, 20, 28]
max_lot = [82, 70, 90]
setup_cost = [52, 60, 45]
holding_cost = [1.2, 1.6, 0.9]
production_cost = [
    [5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8],
    [7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10],
    [9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6],
]
demand = [
    [34, 48, 42, 55, 38, 50, 46, 40],
    [28, 32, 45, 36, 50, 34, 42, 39],
    [40, 35, 38, 44, 36, 48, 41, 45],
]
capacity = [250, 245, 235, 260, 240, 255, 245, 265]

m = Model("packing_plan")
m.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)

x = {}
y = {}
inv = {}
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        x[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name=f"x_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")
        y[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"y_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")
        inv[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=75, name=f"inv_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")

m.setObjective(
    quicksum(
        production_cost[p][t] * x[p, t]
        + setup_cost[p] * y[p, t]
        + holding_cost[p] * inv[p, t]
        for p in products
        for t in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE,
)

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] >= min_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"min_lot_{p+1}_{t+1}")
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] <= max_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"max_lot_{p+1}_{t+1}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, 0] == initial_stock[p] + x[p, 0] - demand[p][0], name=f"balance_{p+1}_1")
    for t in range(1, len(periods)):
        m.addConstr(inv[p, t] == inv[p, t - 1] + x[p, t] - demand[p][t], name=f"balance_{p+1}_{t+1}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, len(periods) - 1] >= required_final[p], name=f"final_inv_{p+1}")

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(quicksum(inv[p, t] for p in products) <= 150, name=f"total_inv_{t+1}")
    m.addConstr(quicksum(hours_per_unit[p] * x[p, t] for p in products) <= capacity[t], name=f"capacity_{t+1}")

m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products for t in periods) <= 18, name="total_setups")

for t in (2, 5):
    m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products) <= 2, name=f"max2_setup_T{t+1}")

m.optimize()

status_names = {
    GRB.OPTIMAL: "OPTIMAL",
    GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
    GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
    GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
    GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
    GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
    GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
    GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
    GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
}

if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    variables = {}
    for v in sorted(m.getVars(), key=lambda var: var.VarName):
        val = float(v.X)
        variables[v.VarName] = 0.0 if abs(val) < 1e-9 else val
    solution = {
        "status": "OPTIMAL",
        "objective": float(m.ObjVal),
        "variables": variables,
    }
else:
    solution = {
        "status": status_names.get(m.status, str(m.status)),
        "objective": 0.0,
        "variables": {},
    }

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(solution, separators=(",", ":")))
```

import json
from gurobipy import GRB, Model, quicksum

products = [0, 1, 2]
periods = list(range(8))

initial_stock = [22, 18, 25]
required_final = [18, 15, 20]
hours_per_unit = [2, 3, 1]
min_lot = [24, 20, 28]
max_lot = [82, 70, 90]
setup_cost = [52, 60, 45]
holding_cost = [1.2, 1.6, 0.9]

demand = [
    [34, 48, 42, 55, 38, 50, 46, 40],
    [28, 32, 45, 36, 50, 34, 42, 39],
    [40, 35, 38, 44, 36, 48, 41, 45],
]

prod_cost = [
    [5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8],
    [7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10],
    [9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6],
]

capacity = [250, 245, 235, 260, 240, 255, 245, 265]

m = Model("packing_plan")
m.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)

x = m.addVars(products, periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="x")
y = m.addVars(products, periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="y")
inv = m.addVars(products, periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=75, name="inv")

m.setObjective(
    quicksum(
        prod_cost[p][t] * x[p, t]
        + setup_cost[p] * y[p, t]
        + holding_cost[p] * inv[p, t]
        for p in products
        for t in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE,
)

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] >= min_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"min_lot_{p}_{t}")
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] <= max_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"max_lot_{p}_{t}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, 0] == initial_stock[p] + x[p, 0] - demand[p][0], name=f"balance_{p}_0")
    for t in range(1, 8):
        m.addConstr(inv[p, t] == inv[p, t - 1] + x[p, t] - demand[p][t], name=f"balance_{p}_{t}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, 7] >= required_final[p], name=f"final_inv_{p}")

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(quicksum(inv[p, t] for p in products) <= 150, name=f"total_inv_{t}")

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(quicksum(hours_per_unit[p] * x[p, t] for p in products) <= capacity[t], name=f"capacity_{t}")

m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products for t in periods) <= 18, name="total_setups")

for t in (2, 5):
    m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products) <= 2, name=f"max2_setup_{t}")

m.optimize()

status_names = {
    GRB.OPTIMAL: "OPTIMAL",
    GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
    GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
    GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
    GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
    GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
    GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
    GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
    GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
}

if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    solution = {
        "status": "OPTIMAL",
        "objective": float(m.ObjVal),
        "variables": {
            v.VarName: float(v.X)
            for v in sorted(m.getVars(), key=lambda var: var.VarName)
        },
    }
else:
    solution = {
        "status": status_names.get(m.status, str(m.status)),
        "objective": 0.0,
        "variables": {},
    }

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(solution, separators=(",", ":")))
```

```
import json
from gurobipy import GRB, Model, quicksum

products = [0, 1, 2]
periods = list(range(8))

initial_stock = [22, 18, 25]
required_final = [18, 15, 20]
hours_per_unit = [2, 3, 1]
min_lot = [24, 20, 28]
max_lot = [82, 70, 90]
setup_cost = [52, 60, 45]
holding_cost = [1.2, 1.6, 0.9]
production_cost = [
    [5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8, 5, 8],
    [7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10, 7, 10],
    [9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6, 9, 6],
]
demand = [
    [34, 48, 42, 55, 38, 50, 46, 40],
    [28, 32, 45, 36, 50, 34, 42, 39],
    [40, 35, 38, 44, 36, 48, 41, 45],
]
capacity = [250, 245, 235, 260, 240, 255, 245, 265]

m = Model("packing_plan")
m.setParam("OutputFlag", 0)

x = {}
y = {}
inv = {}
for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        x[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name=f"x_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")
        y[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.BINARY, name=f"y_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")
        inv[p, t] = m.addVar(vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, ub=75, name=f"inv_P{p+1}_T{t+1}")

m.setObjective(
    quicksum(
        production_cost[p][t] * x[p, t]
        + setup_cost[p] * y[p, t]
        + holding_cost[p] * inv[p, t]
        for p in products
        for t in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE,
)

for p in products:
    for t in periods:
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] >= min_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"min_lot_{p+1}_{t+1}")
        m.addConstr(x[p, t] <= max_lot[p] * y[p, t], name=f"max_lot_{p+1}_{t+1}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, 0] == initial_stock[p] + x[p, 0] - demand[p][0], name=f"balance_{p+1}_1")
    for t in range(1, len(periods)):
        m.addConstr(inv[p, t] == inv[p, t - 1] + x[p, t] - demand[p][t], name=f"balance_{p+1}_{t+1}")

for p in products:
    m.addConstr(inv[p, len(periods) - 1] >= required_final[p], name=f"final_inv_{p+1}")

for t in periods:
    m.addConstr(quicksum(inv[p, t] for p in products) <= 150, name=f"total_inv_{t+1}")
    m.addConstr(quicksum(hours_per_unit[p] * x[p, t] for p in products) <= capacity[t], name=f"capacity_{t+1}")

m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products for t in periods) <= 18, name="total_setups")

for t in (2, 5):
    m.addConstr(quicksum(y[p, t] for p in products) <= 2, name=f"max2_setup_T{t+1}")

m.optimize()

status_names = {
    GRB.OPTIMAL: "OPTIMAL",
    GRB.INFEASIBLE: "INFEASIBLE",
    GRB.UNBOUNDED: "UNBOUNDED",
    GRB.INF_OR_UNBD: "INF_OR_UNBD",
    GRB.TIME_LIMIT: "TIME_LIMIT",
    GRB.NODE_LIMIT: "NODE_LIMIT",
    GRB.ITERATION_LIMIT: "ITERATION_LIMIT",
    GRB.INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
    GRB.NUMERIC: "NUMERIC",
    GRB.SUBOPTIMAL: "SUBOPTIMAL",
}

if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
    variables = {}
    for v in sorted(m.getVars(), key=lambda var: var.VarName):
        val = float(v.X)
        variables[v.VarName] = 0.0 if abs(val) < 1e-9 else val
    solution = {
        "status": "OPTIMAL",
        "objective": float(m.ObjVal),
        "variables": variables,
    }
else:
    solution = {
        "status": status_names.get(m.status, str(m.status)),
        "objective": 0.0,
        "variables": {},
    }

print("SOLUTION_JSON=" + json.dumps(solution, separators=(",", ":")))
```
